pages.text: Health 220, Attack 8, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Movement Speed 0.25.$(br)$(l)Scythe Blade$(): a piercing flying blade that deals 8 damage.$(br)$(l)Double Punishment$(): picks two hostile creatures for 5 + 2%% of their max health over two seconds, while two allies are healed for half the damage dealt.$(br)

$(l)Flying Scythe$(): throws a slow spinning blade that deals 4 magic damage every 0.25 seconds.$(br)$(l)Finger Snap$(): kills the highest-health Reaper servant on the field, heals itself for half of that servant's health, and detonates it and the flying scythes into a shockwave.$(br)$(l)Summon$(): 2-3 Reaper servants.$(br)

Immune to fall and freezing damage; it does not burn in daylight but gains Weakness I, and every hit feeds 15 soul energy back to its owner.$(br)$(l)Upgrades$(): 220-275-550; each level adds +1 to all damage and +10%% scythe width and flight speed; from level 2 its damaging moves apply Erosion for 5 seconds.$(br)
$(l)Extra summon$(): give it a Grave Soul Focus for extra summons -- always 2, with a chance of 1-2 more, cap 6.
